# `fec_contribution_profiles`

**Qualified selected-report contributions**

Qualified selected-report contributions with exact source coordinates and explicit interpretation limits.

**Coverage.** Window. Complete selected recipient report with separate itemized, unitemized, signed-adjustment and refund measures; not a complete cycle. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fec_contribution_profiles.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `profile_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of one selected profile; not an economic transaction ID. |
| `committee_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal native FEC committee ID; no name matching. |
| `committee_name` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher committee label; earlier filing titles remain separately in native evidence. |
| `candidate_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native candidate ID. Different offices may have different IDs for the same person. |
| `candidate_association_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Native committee/cycle link and candidate observation before the report; daily authorization is not asserted. |
| `filing_id` | `VARCHAR` | Native filing number selected by matching publisher report evidence. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original publisher bytes. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher URL recorded for the retained original; its current contents can differ. |
| `captured_at` | `VARCHAR` | Known original capture time; null where historical acquisition time is unknown. |
| `period_start` | `VARCHAR` | Declared report or cycle coverage start, not necessarily the earliest transaction date. |
| `period_end` | `VARCHAR` | Declared report or cycle coverage end, not necessarily the latest transaction date. |
| `source_evidence_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact retained request descriptors, original digests, sizes and capture dates. |
| `policy_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version of the named interpretation and selection rules. |
| `coverage_note` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit population, timing, attribution and financial limits of this named output. |
| `contribution_family` | `VARCHAR` | PAC receipts source-typed PAC, or individual-contribution schedule lines. |
| `gross_itemized_receipts` | `VARCHAR` | Included nonnegative itemized receipts, in exact USD decimal text. |
| `negative_receipt_adjustments` | `VARCHAR` | Signed negative receipt adjustments, distinct from Schedule B refunds. |
| `signed_itemized_receipts` | `VARCHAR` | Gross itemized receipts plus signed adjustments, reconciled to the official report. |
| `itemized_refunds` | `VARCHAR` | Matching family Schedule B refunds; never inferred from a negative receipt sign. |
| `net_itemized_flow` | `VARCHAR` | Signed itemized receipts minus matching itemized refunds, in exact USD decimal text. |
| `unitemized_receipts` | `VARCHAR` | Separate reported unitemized amount; not attributed to named itemized donors. |
| `net_reported_family` | `VARCHAR` | Signed itemized receipts plus separate unitemized receipts minus matching refunds. |
| `amount_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Declared publisher or selected-report measure basis. Alternative representations are not added. |
| `breakdown_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact amounts grouped by native PAC ID or reported contributor state; includes record counts, not unique donors. |
| `source_cycle` | `INTEGER` | Selected two-year FEC cycle or completed result edition. |
| `included_records` | `INTEGER` | Included receipt/refund observation count, not a count of people. |
| `memo_records` | `INTEGER` | Preserved source memo observations excluded from additive money. |
